guideDescription: A fresh-level-80 path into Affliction damage-over-time priorities, execute control, dungeon utility, and later raid progression.

mechanics.label: DoTs
mechanics.use: Maintain effects only when the target will live long enough for their full value.

mechanics.label: Haunt
mechanics.use: Keep Haunt active and use Shadow Bolt to establish and refresh the supporting debuffs.

mechanics.label: Execute
mechanics.use: Below 25%, channel Drain Soul and refresh required effects immediately after a tick.

mechanics.label: Resources
mechanics.use: Maintain Fel Armor, plan Life Tap safely, and arrive with shards, pet, Healthstone, and Soulstone ready.

talent.name: Fresh-80 self-contained Affliction baseline
talent.summary: Use the complete Suppression baseline while early gear is short on hit. Treat threat, range, and raid-composition swaps as later options.

pageDescriptions.quickStart: Start at level 80 with Felhunter setup, DoT priorities, hit assumptions, and a practical dungeon-ready checklist.
pageDescriptions.playing: Manage DoTs, Haunt, Shadow Bolt, Drain Soul, movement, target life, curses, and utility as one priority system.
pageDescriptions.setup: Install the 55/0/16 build, glyphs, pet controls, original-client macros, addons, and tracking.
pageDescriptions.building: Build hit deliberately, then balance spell power, haste, critical strike, Spirit, budget gems, and enchants.
pageDescriptions.equipping: Target normal and heroic dungeon, reputation, crafted, emblem, catch-up, ToC, ICC, and Ruby Sanctum upgrades.
pageDescriptions.raiding: Handle curses, target swaps, execute channels, movement, pet safety, and encounter responsibilities by mode.

serverNote: Standard original-client WotLK 3.3.5a behavior is the baseline. Verify Corruption rollover, Drain Soul tick timing, pet behavior, and encounter-specific immunities on Hellscream.
footer: Unofficial player-made Hellscream guide. Verify live tooltips, raid assignments, and server scripting.
